title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
summary: OmniH2O uses a kinematic-pose interface, a privileged RL teacher, DAgger distillation, sparse head/hand goals, and proprioceptive/action history to deploy whole-body teleoperation on a Unitree H1; the paper also reports a six-task teleoperation dataset and autonomy demonstrations.
